answer: Payment for graded work sits in escrow until the epoch finalizes, and no identity may audit its own recruit. Spawn three clones, grade them yourself, and the payout never clears. Case: A recruits B, B submits, A draws the grading seat, the seat is voided, escrow returns to the pool. So a farm needs real jurors for every submission. A wander across 1,000 accounts needs 1,000 independent gradings, each clearing only at the close, so a comet of activity still waits. Buy all the keys you want, you still cannot sign your own work, and a mesa of flat accounts has no jurors to draw.
